title: HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to implementation of Proposition TE, which proposes a one-time exemption from the City's special documentary transfer tax…
text:
[Council File 26-1612; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to implementation of Proposition TE, which proposes a one-time exemption from the City's special documentary transfer tax established under Measure ULA, for qualifying properties impacted by the January 2025 wildfires.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Park, McOsker – Harris-Dawson):
INSTRUCT the Office of Finance and REQUEST the City Attorney to take the necessary administrative actions to implement Proposition TE upon certification of the election results confirming its passage, and report to the City Council with recommendations for any additional Council actions necessary to ensure its effective implementation.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council motion to implement Proposition TE, a proposed one-time exemption from the city's Measure ULA transfer tax for properties hit by the January 2025 wildfires.
